set.title: US CHIPS follow-through after the awards (2025-2026): disbursements, renegotiated terms, government equity stakes and Section 48D credit claims
set.why_it_matters: Since August 2025 CHIPS money increasingly buys equity, warrants or royalties rather than paying grants; this turns the US government into a shareholder in the supply chain, with implications for governance, exits and competition. Absorbs RU-0257 (48D in practice) and the W1 disbursement unknowns (gap-W1-8c3f): the 48D credit now appears to be worth more to some firms than their grants, so money actually paid, not money awarded, is the figure that matters.
